detail.p1_intro: This tool was developed to provide students with organized access to study guides, problem sets, and solved exams structured by academic semesters and subjects. Its design prioritizes performance, allowing fast filtering and seamless access to cloud-stored resources.
detail.mod_chatbot: Virtual Assistant (Chatbot): Integrated module to assist students by answering questions about web resources and course materials.
detail.mod_search: Dynamic Search & Filters: Optimized search bar for fast subject lookup.
detail.mod_responsive: Responsive Design: Fully fluid interface accessible from any mobile or desktop device.
detail.mod_404: Navigation Control (404 Page): Route error handling with a custom view to guide users back.
detail.mod_admin: Admin Panel: Internal module for agile management, updating, and uploading of academic materials.
